sloka: असमीक्ष्य समारब्धम् विरुद्धम् बुद्धि लाघवात् ।जनयिष्यति सम्क्रोशम् राघवस्य विवासनम् ॥२-५८-३०॥
transliteration: asamīkṣya samārabdham viruddham buddhi lāghavāt ।janayiṣyati samkrośam rāghavasya vivāsanam ॥2-58-30॥

translations.english: 'Unjustly, foolishly and without (proper) consideration Rama has been banished. This will (definitely) cause sorrow'.
